vertical_coordinates.event_z: H + source events.csv z_m (old catalogue depth)

shared_datum_assumption.statement: Catalogue depth and station elevation are assumed to share a vertical datum; this has NOT been verified or corrected.

grids.generation_solver: PyKonal; saved clean absolute times, no new solve

velocity_metric.name: equal-volume cell RMSE against block-averaged-slowness reference
velocity_metric.reference: 1 / volume_mean(1 / original truth velocity) per 1-km cell
velocity_metric.verification: All 14 final_model.npy RMSEs match quality.jsonl iter 11
velocity_metric.caveat: Unlike aligned checkerboards, NOT whole-volume RMSE against original truth; boundaries cross cells.
velocity_metric.supplemental: original_voxel_volume_rmse_m_s repeats constant inversion cells onto original 125-m truth voxels

hypocenter_metric.name: 90th percentile of full Euclidean 3D error
hypocenter_metric.checkpoint: iter_11 E-step preceding twelfth velocity update
hypocenter_metric.estimator: largest saved weight (first argmax on ties), not posterior mean
hypocenter_metric.event_alignment: event_i to events.csv row i, original IDs/order/XYZ hash-identical; complete arrival ID cross-product checked
hypocenter_metric.weights_digest: SHA256(row_index TAB event_id TAB weights_file_SHA256 LF)

controls: dmin2 hard top40 is reused for all dmin2 soft comparisons; dmin4/7 hard top50 and top128 are distinct controls, not independent replicates.
uncertainty: One synthetic realization, seed 42; no replicate uncertainty estimates.
adjacent_section_provenance: real_geometry_comparison_metrics.json hashes original inputs, manifests, run metadata/final models and row-ID-weight digests; same final12/preceding iter11 MAP protocol, but its aligned checkerboard reference equals voxel truth.
